key: nvidia|senior product manager host networking platforms
title: Senior Product Manager – Host Networking Platforms
jd_excerpt:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 In this role, you’ll help build the evolution of host networking technologies developed by NVIDIA, driving platform-level innovation from vision to real-world impact. Your work will influence the most advanced computing environments in the world, empowering industries and researchers to push the limits of performance and possibility. At NVIDIA, you’ll join a varied community united by curiosity, creativity, and a shared mission to change the world, encouraged by these values. Our Host Networking Platform Product Group leads the ConnectX and BlueField DPU product lines - cornerstones of NVIDIA’s data-center and AI strategy. Together, we are building the networking backbone of tomorrow’s intelligent systems and crafting the future of how computation connects.
 What You'll Be Doing: 
 Spearhead the development and seamless integration of sophisticated networking products, redefining innovative concepts into fully realized systems.
 Address complex technical challenges, continuously advancing the frontiers of networking technology to compose solutions that exceed customer expectations.
 Collaborate deeply with multidisciplinary engineering and architecture teams to prioritize and define detailed, actionable requirements for breakthrough projects.
 Forge positive relationships with customers—actively listening to their technical needs, delivering expert mentorship, and supporting successful, large-scale deployments that drive their strategic goals.
 What We Need to See: 
 A BSc or MSc or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, or comparable practical experience in a closely related field.
 At least 12 years of product or program management experience within the semiconductor or networking industry, spanning end-to-end hardware and software systems.
 Proven track record to bring deep customer and business insights to networking solutions, with a strong grasp of the needs of cloud providers, enterprises, platform integrators, and network equipment vendors.
 Demonstrated expertise collaborating with leading Enterprise clients and top 5 Cloud Service Providers to successfully deliver product releases and manage large-scale deployments.
 Advanced analytical skills, combined with proven experience in strong product and project management in dynamic, technical environments.
 Outstanding communication skills, demonstrated in both technical and business interactions.
 Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: 
 Demonstrated expertise in embedded platforms, spanning hardware, system infrastructure, and application-level innovation.
 Proven success partnering with global, enterprise-scale customers on networking and cloud infrastructure deployments.
 Hands-on experience with NVIDIA technologies and embedded solutions, showing a deep understanding of our platform ecosystem.
 Track record of leading embedded systems development, combining technical depth with impactful leadership.
 History of excelling in product management within international organizations, highlighting adaptability and cross-cultural collaboration.
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ ​
